title: bug: when a deregister closes a worktree worker's finalizing attempt before anything was published (the IDE closed the seat's tab mid-landing), the REVIEW row is left with no completion and no landingRetry, so QA's landed gate parks it BLOCKED and only a governor reopen recovers it, which resets every step (task-87cba58c, 11-04 00:30Z)
description:
Seen live on task-87cba58c (11-04, governor-e6142a94):
- 00:21:32Z: worker-2dc72348 calls complete_task, and the row goes to REVIEW with the attempt finalizing.
- 00:21:59Z: its wrapper's L0-L2 commits W to moe/task/task-87cba58c… as checkpoint 75355f80. The wrapper then waits in L3 for the git-land lease (the live edc27e14 still has the 946358a8 wake bug).
- 00:30:15Z: the IDE close deregisters every seat (terminal_closed). closeOwnFinalizingAttempts (state/workerLifecycle.ts:248, called at :291) closes attempt-6f2bc0c2 at 00:30:15.062Z.
- Nothing was published: .git/moe/receipt/ is empty, there is no refs/moe/rescue/task-87cba58c… ref, task.commits is [], and origin/moe/work-2026-10-24 has no feat(task-87cba58c) commit.
- The row stays REVIEW and unassigned. At 05:24:32Z qa-58a8e460 claims it. qa_landed_gate stops it with MOE_CONTROL_CHECKOUT_BEHIND ("no recorded completion commit") and report_blocks the row (05:25:21Z). Nothing auto-heals it.

Why every recovery hurts:
- The route that fits is finalize_attempt's unlanded branch (tools/finalizeAttempt.ts:150-171, applyTaskOutcome): REVIEW → WORKING, unassigned, task.landingRetry set, no reopen. The next worker's worktree_resume (scripts/moe-agent.sh ~:7970-7990) then merges the target into W and prompts LANDING-RETRY. But that branch needs a finalizing attempt, and this one is already closed.
- The governor's only lever is set_task_status WORKING. From a blocked REVIEW row that is a reopen (setTaskStatus.ts:221, isReopening via effectiveFrom), so buildReopenClearingUpdates (util/reopen.ts:49) resets every plan step to PENDING and reopenCount goes up. A worker then re-walks a finished plan only to re-land bytes already on the task branch.
- closeOwnFinalizingAttempts' own comment (workerLifecycle.ts:228) says the close is "not evidence of a landing", and that under the legacy delivery policy NO-COMPLETION-COMMIT is the only guard. Worktree mode's landed gate now turns that gap into a BLOCKED row.
- The same close also runs from the DEAD-record backstop (workerStore.ts:249, :372).

Expected: when one of these closes ends a worker's finalizing attempt on a worktree-mode task (attempt workspaceMode 'worktree') that is REVIEW with no completion recorded for its current round (delivery/policy.ts:206 completionCommitsForReview), route the row exactly as the unlanded route does: WORKING, unassigned, landingRetry with a task comment, and no reopenCount bump or step reset. Use a reason the launchers already accept ("conflict","contention","gate","diverged","remote"; moe-agent.sh:7984 and its ps1 twin), for example contention, so no launcher edit is needed. Keep today's close for a row whose completion is recorded, for shared mode, and for non-REVIEW rows.
Pitfalls:
- A dead wrapper may have published C without recording it. Its receipt journal then survives, and the next pre-flight's receipt replay records the owed row. Do not try to read git from the daemon.
- Keep the close itself unconditional, so a dying runner still cannot wedge its row (task-686afecb's rail: never close or release on an idle signal; the DEAD-record backstop stays DEAD-only).
definitionOfDone: A daemon test fails on today's code: a worktree-mode task in REVIEW whose worker attempt is finalizing, with no completion commit for the current round, goes through moe.deregister_worker. The test passes when the attempt is closed AND the task ends WORKING, unassigned, with landingRetry set (a reason worktree_resume accepts), reopenCount unchanged and every plan step still COMPLETED. The DEAD-record backstop path (deleteWorker / startup purge) is covered the same way.

Tests prove today's behaviour is kept for a REVIEW task whose completion is recorded for the round, for a shared-mode attempt, and for a non-REVIEW row: the attempt is closed and status and landingRetry are untouched.

The `### moe.deregister_worker` section of docs/MCP_SERVER.md describes the new routing, and so does the list of paths that end a finalizing attempt in `### moe.finalize_attempt` if it has one. `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass in packages/moe-daemon.

implementationPlan.description:
Share finalize's unlanded routing; finalize's behavior must not change. Move the body of `if (params.unlanded) { ... }` in applyTaskOutcome (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/finalizeAttempt.ts:153-172) into a new export in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/workerLifecycle.ts:
  export async function routeUnlandedLanding(state, task: Task, attempt: Pick<ExecutionAttempt,'id'|'generation'>, unlanded: Omit<LandingRetry,'count'|'at'>, actor: string, note?: string): Promise<Task>
It is the same count, status, comment, routing and BLOCKED logic, and the same updateTask call. The one change: a given `note` opens the comment, as `${note} Landing unlanded (...`. With no note, the comment and the blockedReason are byte-identical to today's.

In finalizeAttempt.ts, applyTaskOutcome's branch becomes `if (params.unlanded) return routeUnlandedLanding(state, task, attempt, params.unlanded, actor);`. Replace its now-unused `import { generateId } from '../util/ids.js';` with `import { routeUnlandedLanding } from '../state/workerLifecycle.js';`. The LandingRetry type import stays, because FinalizeParams uses it.

workerLifecycle.ts gains the ExecutionAttempt and LandingRetry type imports and `import { generateId } from '../util/ids.js';`. Give the helper a docblock: the one definition behind finalize's 'unlanded' outcome and the close routing in step 3; caller holds state.mutex.

No import cycle: tools already import state/workerLifecycle.js (claimNextTask, deregisterWorker, releaseTask), and no state module imports tools/. finalizeAttempt.test.ts pins the comment text, BLOCKED rule and counting, and must pass unchanged.

The dry-run diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-efe07ce5/code.diff (2 files, +73/-22, steps 2 and 3 together). Use your own editor (Edit, apply_patch or a Serena editor), never a shell write.

Route the close. In closeOwnFinalizingAttempts (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/workerLifecycle.ts:248), right after `announceAttemptClosed(state, attempt.taskId);`, add `await retryUnrecordedLanding(state, attempt);`. That is a new, non-exported function, given in code.diff:
- Error handling: the whole body sits in try/catch. On error: logger.warn({ workerId, attemptId, taskId, error }, '... the row stays in REVIEW'). It never throws, so deregister, the prune and the purge never fail on it, and the close stands.
- The predicate: attempt.workspaceMode === 'worktree', and state.getTask(attempt.taskId) exists, has status 'REVIEW', has no assignedWorkerId, and completionCommitsForReview(task).length === 0. Import completionCommitsForReview from '../delivery/policy.js'; state/taskStore.ts already imports that module, so this adds no cycle.
- The route: routeUnlandedLanding(state, task, attempt, { reason: 'contention', paths: [], rescueRef: `refs/heads/moe/task/${task.id}`, targetTip: null }, attempt.workerId, a note). The note is `The runner of ${attempt.workerId} ended mid-landing: attempt ${attempt.id} was closed with no completion recorded for this round.`

Why:
- 'contention' is a reason both launchers already accept (moe-agent.sh:7984 and its ps1 twin), so no launcher edit is needed.
- The task branch is the ref that holds the bytes: L0-L2 committed W there, and the next pre-flight's recovery checkpoint commits any dirt W still has.
- The 3rd unlanded landing in a row goes BLOCKED, exactly as finalize's route does.
- The unassigned guard means a row another seat holds is never yanked.

Keep:
- The close first and unconditional (task-686afecb's rail: never close or release on an idle signal).
- The DEAD-record backstop DEAD-only. state/workerStore.ts needs no change: deleteWorker (:249) and purgeAllWorkers (:372) already call closeOwnFinalizingAttempts, so they inherit the routing.
- No git reads. A commit a dead runner published without recording it is settled by the next pre-flight's receipt replay.

Also add one sentence about the routing to the 'WHAT IT IS NOT' paragraph of closeOwnFinalizingAttempts' docblock (:228-234).

Verification. Run it once, before moe.complete_task; its fresh output is the completion evidence. From the task worktree root, run the executionContract checkRef exactly as written. The same text (971 chars) is at /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-efe07ce5/checkref-gate.txt.

What it does (mem:convention-daemon-full-suite-gate-checkref, mem:gotcha-harness-snapshot-needs-full-archive):
- It overlays the six owned files (the two runtime files, the new test, types/schema.ts and both docs) onto a whole-tree `git archive HEAD` snapshot made by mktemp, outside the repo.
- Under env -i, with nvm Node v24.21.0 and NO_COLOR=1, it runs `npm ci`, `tsc --noEmit`, then `tsc -p tt.json`, which types the new test.
- Stage 1 runs vitest on finalizingCloseRetry, attemptHandback and finalizeAttempt, and pins '(11 tests)'.
- Stage 2 runs the full `npm test` (plain `vitest run`, no pretest), as DoD 3 asks.

Expected, from the architect's dry run of the prototype at d1062cb0: stage 1 'Test Files 3 passed (3)' / 'Tests 115 passed (115)'; full suite 'Test Files 281 passed (281)' / 'Tests 7445 passed | 24 skipped (7469)'; exit 0, about 50 s. Your counts may differ by the tests siblings landed since.

Rules:
- Never run npm in the shared checkout (global rail).
- Never pass TMPDIR into the env -i.
- The outer command needs bash, for its brace expansion.

Adversarial self-review, the final step. Load the adversarial-self-review skill and read your diff as an attacker.
- Refactor fidelity: with note undefined, routeUnlandedLanding's comment and blockedReason are byte-identical to the removed finalize code. Diff the moved block against `git show HEAD:packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/finalizeAttempt.ts`. finalizeAttempt.test.ts passes unchanged.
- Close first: the attempt is closed and announced before any routing. A failed routing write never fails deregister, the prune or the purge, and never leaves the attempt finalizing.
- The predicate, case by case:
  - shared and mode-less attempts: plain close;
  - a row not in REVIEW (a human qa_reject sent it to WORKING while the landing ran): plain close;
  - an assigned REVIEW row: plain close;
  - a completion recorded before the round started: routes;
  - a completion recorded in the round: plain close;
  - a missing task (deleted out of band): plain close.
- Interleaving: every caller holds the state mutex (the deregister tool runs under McpAdapter's dispatch lock; deleteWorker and purgeAllWorkers take state.mutex), so no claim can land between the close and the route.
  - A QA waiter woken by the close's TASK_UPDATED claims only after the lock is released, by when the row is WORKING.
  - The routed row is WORKING and unassigned with all steps done. nextStatusForRelease keeps a landingRetry row in WORKING (workerLifecycle.ts:111), and a worker's claim gets the LANDING-RETRY resume.
- Repeats: a second deregister finds no finalizing attempt and routes nothing. The 3rd unlanded landing in a row is BLOCKED, so a seat that keeps dying cannot loop the row forever.
- Startup purge: routing at startup runs before any seat connects. updateTask's system message is best-effort and cannot fail the purge.
- Docs: each claim in the new bullets matches the code (reason, rescueRef, guard list, BLOCKED rule). No other section was touched.

If anything changes, re-run the step-5 checkRef and submit that fresh output.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 6 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: When moe.deregister_worker, or the removal of a DEAD worker record (the stale-record prune in deleteWorker, or the startup purge), closes a worker's finalizing attempt, the close sometimes also routes the row. It does so for a worktree attempt (workspaceMode 'worktree') whose task is in REVIEW, held by no seat, with no completion entry for its current round (completionCommitsForReview). The row is then routed exactly as moe.finalize_attempt's 'unlanded' outcome routes it: landingRetry { reason: 'contention', paths: [], rescueRef: 'refs/heads/moe/task/<taskId>', targetTip: null, count: prior + 1, at }, one moe-daemon comment naming the attempt, and status WORKING, unassigned, with reopenCount and every completed step kept. The third unlanded landing in a row goes BLOCKED, unblocking to WORKING. The close itself stays first and unconditional, and every other close is unchanged. finalize_attempt's own unlanded routing is unchanged byte for byte, because both paths call one shared helper. QA's landed gate therefore no longer parks such a row BLOCKED: the next worker's pre-flight merges the target and prompts LANDING-RETRY: contention.
acceptanceCriteria: New state/finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts covers each close path: moe.deregister_worker, the DEAD-record prune (deleteWorker) and the startup purge (purgeAllWorkers). Each closes worker-1's finalizing worktree attempt on unassigned REVIEW task-1 with no completion this round. The attempt ends closed. The task ends WORKING, unassigned, with reopenCount and its COMPLETED steps unchanged, and landingRetry { reason 'contention', paths [], rescueRef 'refs/heads/moe/task/task-1', targetTip null, count 1 }. There is one moe-daemon comment naming the attempt. All three cases fail on the code at d1062cb0.
A completion recorded before the round started does not stop the routing. A prior landingRetry count of 2 makes the row BLOCKED (blockedFromStatus WORKING, count 3), as an unlanded finalize does.

The plain close is kept: the attempt is closed, and status, assignee, comments and landingRetry are untouched. The cases: a REVIEW row with a completion recorded this round, a shared-mode attempt, a mode-less attempt, a row not in REVIEW, and a REVIEW row another seat holds.
A routing write that fails never fails the close: deregister succeeds, the attempt is closed, and the row stays REVIEW without landingRetry.

finalizeAttempt.test.ts and state/attemptHandback.test.ts pass unchanged. The daemon's full `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass in a snapshot. docs/MCP_SERVER.md's ### moe.deregister_worker and ### moe.finalize_attempt (the 'Every end of a finalizing attempt' list) describe the routing.
invariants: closeOwnFinalizingAttempts closes and announces each finalizing attempt before any routing. The routing never throws, and a failed routing write leaves the close standing (task-686afecb's rail: nothing closes or releases on an idle signal).
The DEAD-record backstop stays DEAD-only. state/workerStore.ts is unchanged, and deleteWorker/purgeAllWorkers reach the routing only through closeOwnFinalizingAttempts.
The daemon never reads git for this decision. The only evidence is task.commits through completionCommitsForReview.
With no note, routeUnlandedLanding's comment, blockedReason, counting and BLOCKED rule are byte-identical to finalize_attempt's code at d1062cb0.
A row held by another seat, a row not in REVIEW, and a non-worktree attempt are never routed.
compatibility: No MCP wire change: deregister_worker's return shape and releasedTaskIds are unchanged (routed rows were already unassigned), and finalize_attempt's inputs, outputs and refusals are unchanged.

The LandingRetry shape is unchanged: rescueRef stays a string, now the task branch for a close-routed retry. Both launchers' worktree_resume already accept reason 'contention' and ignore rescueRef, so no launcher edit is needed.
Legacy attempts with no workspaceMode keep the plain close. No .moe/ state migration.
approvedScope: state/workerLifecycle.ts: an exported routeUnlandedLanding (moved from finalizeAttempt.ts applyTaskOutcome, plus an optional note), a private retryUnrecordedLanding, its one call in closeOwnFinalizingAttempts, and one docblock sentence.
tools/finalizeAttempt.ts: applyTaskOutcome's unlanded branch calls routeUnlandedLanding; the import swaps generateId for routeUnlandedLanding.

Docs and comments: docs/MCP_SERVER.md ### moe.deregister_worker (one new bullet) and ### moe.finalize_attempt (items 2 and 5 of 'Every end of a finalizing attempt'); docs/SCHEMA.md landingRetry (:501, :847, :855); types/schema.ts comments only (:873, :1063). No launcher, workerStore.ts or other section change.
reuse: completionCommitsForReview (delivery/policy.ts:206) is the round rule qa_approve's commit gate and the strict delivery policies already share.
finalize_attempt's routing is moved into one shared helper, not copied, so both routes stay identical.
deleteWorker (workerStore.ts:249) and purgeAllWorkers (:372) inherit the routing through closeOwnFinalizingAttempts.
sourceAssumptions: closeOwnFinalizingAttempts (state/workerLifecycle.ts:248) is the only close of a worker's finalizing attempts for deregisterWorker (:291), deleteWorker (workerStore.ts:249) and purgeAllWorkers (workerStore.ts:372). Each caller holds state.mutex.

finalizeAttempt.ts applyTaskOutcome (:150-177) holds the unlanded routing: count = prior + 1; REVIEW goes to WORKING, unassigned, or to BLOCKED for diverged or count >= 3; one comment authored moe-daemon; updateTask with actor.
attempt.workspaceMode is pinned 'worktree' by a worktree WORKING claim (state/validators.ts:318). A legacy attempt has none.
Only record_commit's outcome 'committed' appends task.commits (tools/recordCommit.ts:302), so a failed or nothing landing adds no completion entry.
moe-agent.sh worktree_resume (:7982-7984) and Invoke-MoeWorktreeResume (moe-agent.ps1:7617) accept the reasons conflict, contention, gate, diverged and remote, and read only reason and paths.
nextStatusForRelease keeps a WORKING row with landingRetry in WORKING (workerLifecycle.ts:111).
checkRefs: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && S=$(mktemp -d) && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && cp --parents packages/moe-daemon/src/{state/{workerLifecycle,finalizingCloseRetry.test},tools/finalizeAttempt,types/schema}.ts docs/{MCP_SERVER,SCHEMA}.md "$S" && cd "$S/packages/moe-daemon" && printf '{"extends":"./tsconfig.json","compilerOptions":{"noEmit":true,"types":["node"]},"include":["src/state/finalizingCloseRetry.test.ts"],"exclude":[]}' > tt.json && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" NO_COLOR=1 bash -c 'npm ci >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p tt.json && { npx vitest run src/state/{finalizingCloseRetry,attemptHandback}.test.ts src/tools/finalizeAttempt.test.ts > ../r 2>&1; r=$?; grep -aE "^ +(Test Files|Tests) |^ FAIL " ../r; [ $r = 0 ]; } && grep -aqE "finalizingCloseRetry\.test\.ts \(11 tests\)" ../r && { npm test > ../v 2>&1; r=$?; grep -aE "^ +(Test Files|Tests) |^ FAIL " ../v; exit $r; }'

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Duplicate the routing in workerLifecycle.ts and leave finalizeAttempt.ts alone. That saves one file but copies the count, comment and BLOCKED rule, which then drift. Rejected: the row asks for routing 'exactly as the unlanded route does'. (2) Route only inside deregisterWorker. Rejected: the DEAD-record prune and the startup purge would still strand the row, and DoD 1 names them. (3) A new unlanded reason such as 'interrupted'. Rejected: it needs both launchers changed. (4) Make LandingRetry.rescueRef nullable. Rejected: a shared-type change, when the task branch honestly names the ref that holds the bytes. (5) Read git from the daemon to tell a published-but-unrecorded C. Forbidden by the row; the receipt replay settles that case.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: All three close paths funnel through closeOwnFinalizingAttempts, so one hook covers deregister, the DEAD-record prune and the startup purge. Only record_commit's 'committed' outcome enters task.commits, so completionCommitsForReview counts exactly the landed completions of the round. The launchers' worktree_resume reads only reason and paths (rescueRef is display-only). nextStatusForRelease already keeps a landingRetry WORKING row in WORKING. The prototype was dry-run at d1062cb0: RED 5 failed / 110 passed in the focused set; GREEN focused 115 passed, full daemon suite 281 files, 7445 passed, 24 skipped, exit 0 in about 50 s. Artifacts are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-efe07ce5/ (the test, code.diff and checkref-gate.txt).
planningNotes.risks: The plan touches 6 distinct files, so submit_plan warns on size; 3 of them are doc or comment syncs. docs/MCP_SERVER.md is also declared by open rows 87cba58c (submit_plan section) and 1f84f4e4 (activity log section). Edit only the two named sections so merge-tree lands them all. A published-but-unrecorded completion is first routed to WORKING; the receipt replay then records the row, and the next worker's retry lands nothing-to-commit, which clears landingRetry. That is self-healing, at the cost of one extra worker session. The routing runs at startup inside purgeAllWorkers too, which is fine because updateTask's side effects are best-effort.
